title: The Star That Erupted With a Perfectly Timed Signal—Like a Trap
hook: A star 1,500 light-years away suddenly blasts a radio pulse so precisely timed, astronomers suspect it's not natural—and the pattern resembles a hunter's lure.
why_this_can_go_viral: The predator-prey framing transforms a cosmic anomaly into an existential thriller—viewers will share because it implies we might be prey.

title: The Classified 'Project Stardust'—A Crashed Probe from Another Solar System
hook: Declassified files reveal the U.S. government secretly recovered a probe that fell to Earth in 1997—and it wasn't built by humans.
why_this_can_go_viral: Conspiracy and real declassification overlap perfectly; the 'crashed probe' hook taps into decades of UFO lore with a fresh, document-backed angle.

title: The Dark Matter Void That's Growing—And It's Pointed at Earth
hook: A massive region of empty space is expanding toward our solar system, and astrophysicists have no idea what's causing it—or what's on the other side.
why_this_can_go_viral: The 'void pointed at Earth' creates a sense of impending doom combined with total mystery—perfect for doomscroll triggers.

title: The Asteroid That Entered the Solar System—Then Started Decelerating
hook: In 2017, an interstellar object slowed down as it passed the Sun, as if it was braking—and NASA still refuses to call it artificial.
why_this_can_go_viral: The 'braking' detail is a bombshell twist on a widely known anomaly—everyone remembers Oumuamua, but few know it slowed down.

title: The Fermi Paradox Answer Buried in a Mass Extinction Event
hook: The same cosmic blast that wiped out 85% of life on Earth 360 million years ago may have also erased every civilization within 5,000 light-years.
why_this_can_go_viral: Linking the Fermi Paradox to a real extinction event makes the 'great filter' feel tangible and terrifyingly close to home.

title: The Extinction Event That Was a 1-Second Flash of Pure Fire
hook: A hypernova 4,000 light-years away released more energy in one second than the Milky Way does in a year—and it happened only 1,000 years ago.
why_this_can_go_viral: The '1,000 years ago' time frame makes it feel like a near-miss extinction—catastrophically recent on cosmic scales.

title: The Signal That Repeated Every 16 Days—Then Changed to a Threat
hook: A repeating radio signal from deep space pulsed like clockwork for four years—then its pattern shifted to a countdown, and astronomers went silent.
why_this_can_go_viral: The 'countdown' twist transforms a scientific anomaly into a ticking clock thriller—pure viral fuel.

title: The Asteroid That Hit Earth—And Then Disappeared From All Records
hook: An asteroid impact in Siberia in 1996 was confirmed by seismic sensors, but every record of it was scrubbed—including satellite imagery from that day.
why_this_can_go_viral: The 'disappeared from records' detail taps into deep distrust of authorities—perfect for conspiracy-minded audiences.

title: The Rogue Black Hole That's Shooting a Jet Straight at Earth
hook: Astronomers discovered a black hole 7,800 light-years away with a relativistic jet aimed directly at us—and it's brightening.
why_this_can_go_viral: A 'death beam' aimed at Earth is the ultimate cosmic horror—the brightening detail creates a sense of mounting danger.

title: The Extinction Comet That Left a Shockwave Frozen in Glass
hook: In the Sahara, scientists found a layer of black glass formed 12,000 years ago—from an airburst so hot it melted sand, but no crater exists.
why_this_can_go_viral: The 'frozen glass' visual is stunning and mysterious—implies a civilization-ending event that left no crater but a ghost of heat.

title: The Fermi Paradox Filter That's Already Inside Our DNA
hook: A study found a recurring pattern in the human genome that looks like an engineered kill switch—and it matches a signal from deep space.
why_this_can_go_viral: Combines genetic horror with cosmic conspiracy—the idea that we're programmed to self-destruct is maximally unsettling.

title: The Star That Reversed Its Magnetic Field—And Became a Bomb
hook: A star 4,000 light-years away flipped its magnetic poles in a single day—and now it's emitting X-ray bursts that could trigger a supernova at any moment.
why_this_can_go_viral: The 'became a bomb' hook turns stellar physics into a ticking time bomb narrative.

title: The Classified 'Project Horizon'—A Moon Base Built to Watch Earth
hook: Declassified U.S. Army documents reveal a 1959 plan to build a nuclear-powered base on the Moon—not for science, but to monitor and control Earth from above.
why_this_can_go_viral: The 'control from above' angle reframes Moon exploration as a surveillance project—taps into paranoia and hidden history.

title: The Dark Matter Ring That's Warping Time Around Earth
hook: A ring of dark matter 300 light-years wide is bending light around our solar system, creating a lens that hides everything beyond—including incoming threats.
why_this_can_go_viral: The 'hides threats' implication turns a scientific concept into a survival horror premise.

title: The Signal That Was Sent From Inside a Neutron Star
hook: A bizarre radio burst came from the heart of a neutron star—a place where matter is crushed into a superfluid and no signal should escape.
why_this_can_go_viral: The 'impossible signal' from an inaccessible place creates a perfect mystery—suggests something inside is communicating.

title: The Extinction Event That Scientists Triggered By Accident
hook: In 1962, a high-altitude nuclear test knocked out satellites and created an artificial radiation belt—scientists later realized they nearly ignited the atmosphere.
why_this_can_go_viral: The 'accidentally almost killed everyone' story is terrifying, true, and almost unknown—perfect for virality.

title: The Black Hole That's Spinning So Fast It's Ripping Spacetime
hook: A supermassive black hole is spinning at 99% the speed of light, dragging spacetime into a vortex that could fling entire star systems into another dimension.
why_this_can_go_viral: The 'ripping spacetime' and 'another dimension' hooks are pure sci-fi fuel grounded in real physics.

title: The Classified Navy Program That Tracked an Alien Fleet
hook: Leaked Navy documents describe a training exercise where radar operators tracked a formation of objects moving in perfect formation—until they vanished into the ocean.
why_this_can_go_viral: Navy leaks are already viral—adding 'alien fleet' and 'ocean vanish' creates an irresistible mystery.

title: The Star That Emits a Perfectly Silent Scream—And It's Getting Louder
hook: A star is emitting neutrinos with a frequency that increases every year—as if it's screaming in a frequency we can't hear, but the pitch is rising.
why_this_can_go_viral: The 'silent scream that's getting louder' is a haunting metaphor that translates cosmic physics into emotional horror.

title: The Fermi Paradox Warning That Came From a Dead Planet
hook: A signal from a planet that died 2 billion years ago was finally decoded—it contains a warning: 'Do not amplify your civilization's energy footprint.'
why_this_can_go_viral: The warning is perfectly timed for the climate change era—connects cosmic dread with immediate human behavior.
